title: Olink® Target 48 Part 3/3: Detection
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Transfer primers and samples
steps.instruction: Transfer primers to the left 48 wells and samples to the right 48 wells of the Fluidigm detection plate according to the provided mapping image.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the required protocol parameters in the input fields above the protocol.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload the .json labware files if needed.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: In the Protocol tab of the Opentrons App, upload the .py protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate the labware, tip rack, and pipette using the Opentrons App (refer to support articles for calibration tips).

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ to start the detection protocol on the robot.
